local Sets = require("grounding")
local Graph = {}
Graph.__index = Graph

local function pair(first, second)
    return math.min(first, second) .. ":" .. math.max(first, second)
end

local function compatible(facts, mutexes)
    local ordered = Sets.sorted(facts)
    for i, first in ipairs(ordered) do
        for j = i + 1, #ordered do if mutexes[pair(first, ordered[j])] then return false end end
    end
    return true
end

local function conflict(first, second, mutexes)
    if Sets.intersects(first.delete, Sets.union(second.pre, second.add))
        or Sets.intersects(second.delete, Sets.union(first.pre, first.add)) then return true end
    for p in pairs(first.pre) do for q in pairs(second.pre) do if mutexes[pair(p, q)] then return true end end end
    return false
end

function Graph.new(actions, initial, goal, limit)
    return setmetatable({actions = actions, goal = goal, limit = limit, facts = {initial}, fact_mutexes = {{}},
        elements = {}, element_mutexes = {}, achievers = {}, memo = {}, lines = {}, searched = 0, memo_hits = 0, tried = 0}, Graph)
end

function Graph:expand(level)
    local facts, mutexes, elements = self.facts[level + 1], self.fact_mutexes[level + 1], {}
    for _, action in ipairs(self.actions) do
        if Sets.subset(action.pre, facts) and compatible(action.pre, mutexes) then elements[#elements + 1] = action end
    end
    local action_count = #elements
    for _, fact in ipairs(Sets.sorted(facts)) do elements[#elements + 1] = {pre = {[fact] = true}, add = {[fact] = true}, delete = {}} end
    local exclusive = {}
    for i, first in ipairs(elements) do
        for j = i + 1, #elements do if conflict(first, elements[j], mutexes) then exclusive[pair(i, j)] = true end end
    end
    self.lines[#self.lines + 1] = string.format("action level %d: actions=%d noops=%d mutexes=%d", level, action_count,
        Sets.size(facts), Sets.size(exclusive))
    local achievers, following, following_mutexes = {}, {}, {}
    for index, element in ipairs(elements) do
        for fact in pairs(element.add) do
            achievers[fact] = achievers[fact] or {}
            local list = achievers[fact]
            list[#list + 1], following[fact] = index, true
        end
    end
    for _, list in pairs(achievers) do
        table.sort(list, function(a, b) return (elements[a].number or 0) < (elements[b].number or 0) end)
    end
    local ordered = Sets.sorted(following)
    for i, first in ipairs(ordered) do
        for j = i + 1, #ordered do
            local second, all_exclusive = ordered[j], true
            for _, x in ipairs(achievers[first]) do
                for _, y in ipairs(achievers[second]) do
                    if x == y or not exclusive[pair(x, y)] then all_exclusive = false; break end
                end
                if not all_exclusive then break end
            end
            if all_exclusive then following_mutexes[pair(first, second)] = true end
        end
    end
    self.elements[level + 1], self.element_mutexes[level + 1], self.achievers[level + 1] = elements, exclusive, achievers
    self.facts[level + 2], self.fact_mutexes[level + 2] = following, following_mutexes
end

function Graph:extract(level, goals)
    if level == 0 then return {} end
    local key = level .. ":" .. table.concat(goals, ",")
    if self.memo[key] then self.memo_hits = self.memo_hits + 1; return nil end
    self.searched = self.searched + 1
    local layers = self:assign(level, goals, 1, {})
    if not layers then self.memo[key] = true end
    return layers
end

function Graph:assign(level, goals, position, chosen)
    local elements = self.elements[level]
    while position <= #goals do
        local covered = false
        for _, index in ipairs(chosen) do if elements[index].add[goals[position]] then covered = true; break end end
        if not covered then break end
        position = position + 1
    end
    if position > #goals then
        local previous, layer = {}, {}
        for _, index in ipairs(chosen) do
            local element = elements[index]
            for fact in pairs(element.pre) do previous[fact] = true end
            if element.number then layer[#layer + 1] = element.number end
        end
        local layers = self:extract(level - 1, Sets.sorted(previous))
        if not layers then return nil end
        table.sort(layer)
        layers[#layers + 1] = layer
        return layers
    end
    for _, index in ipairs(self.achievers[level][goals[position]]) do
        local allowed = true
        for _, other in ipairs(chosen) do if self.element_mutexes[level][pair(index, other)] then allowed = false; break end end
        if allowed then
            self.tried = self.tried + 1
            chosen[#chosen + 1] = index
            local layers = self:assign(level, goals, position + 1, chosen)
            chosen[#chosen] = nil
            if layers then return layers end
        end
    end
end

function Graph:finish(status, layers)
    layers = layers or {}
    local plan = {}
    for _, layer in ipairs(layers) do for _, number in ipairs(layer) do plan[#plan + 1] = number end end
    return {status = status, plan = plan, layers = layers, lines = self.lines, expanded = self.searched,
        generated = self.tried, memo_hits = self.memo_hits}
end

function Graph:run()
    for level = 0, self.limit do
        local facts, mutexes = self.facts[level + 1], self.fact_mutexes[level + 1]
        self.lines[#self.lines + 1] = string.format("fact level %d: facts=%d mutexes=%d", level, Sets.size(facts), Sets.size(mutexes))
        local possible = Sets.subset(self.goal, facts) and compatible(self.goal, mutexes)
        if possible then
            local searched, hits = self.searched, self.memo_hits
            local layers = self:extract(level, Sets.sorted(self.goal))
            self.lines[#self.lines + 1] = string.format("extract level %d: %s searched=%d memo_hits=%d", level,
                layers and "success" or "fail", self.searched - searched, self.memo_hits - hits)
            if layers then return self:finish("solved", layers) end
        elseif level >= 1 and Sets.size(facts) == Sets.size(self.facts[level]) and Sets.size(mutexes) == Sets.size(self.fact_mutexes[level]) then
            return self:finish("unreachable")
        end
        if level == self.limit then return self:finish("level limit") end
        self:expand(level)
    end
end

return Graph

local Parser = require("pddl_parser")
local Grounding = {}

function Grounding.copy(items)
    local result = {}
    for key, value in pairs(items) do result[key] = value end
    return result
end

function Grounding.size(items)
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(items) do count = count + 1 end
    return count
end

function Grounding.sorted(items)
    local result = {}
    for item in pairs(items) do result[#result + 1] = item end
    table.sort(result)
    return result
end

function Grounding.key(items)
    return table.concat(Grounding.sorted(items), ",")
end

function Grounding.subset(first, second)
    for item in pairs(first) do if not second[item] then return false end end
    return true
end

function Grounding.intersects(first, second)
    for item in pairs(first) do if second[item] then return true end end
    return false
end

function Grounding.union(first, second)
    local result = Grounding.copy(first)
    for key, value in pairs(second) do result[key] = value end
    return result
end

function Grounding.difference(first, second)
    local result = {}
    for key, value in pairs(first) do if not second[key] then result[key] = value end end
    return result
end

function Grounding.intersection(first, second)
    local result = {}
    for key, value in pairs(first) do if second[key] then result[key] = value end end
    return result
end

function Grounding.subtype(parents, actual, expected)
    while actual do
        if actual == expected then return true end
        actual = parents[actual]
    end
    return false
end

function Grounding.classes(domain)
    local fluent, static = {}, {}
    for _, action in ipairs(domain.actions) do for _, literal in ipairs(action.effects) do fluent[literal.atom.predicate] = true end end
    for _, name in ipairs(domain.predicate_order) do if not fluent[name] then static[name] = true end end
    return fluent, static
end

function Grounding.substitute(atom, binding)
    local expression = {atom.predicate}
    for _, term in ipairs(atom.terms) do expression[#expression + 1] = binding[term] end
    return Parser.atom(expression)
end

function Grounding.atom_set(atoms)
    local result = {}
    for _, atom in ipairs(atoms) do result[atom.key] = atom end
    return result
end

function Grounding.ground(domain, problem)
    local objects_by_type, initial_atoms = {}, Grounding.atom_set(problem.initial)
    for _, kind in ipairs(domain.type_order) do
        local objects = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(problem.object_order) do
            if Grounding.subtype(domain.parents, problem.objects[name], kind) then objects[#objects + 1] = name end
        end
        objects_by_type[kind] = objects
    end
    local candidates, statistics = {}, {}
    for _, schema in ipairs(domain.actions) do
        local choices, assignments = {}, 1
        for i, parameter in ipairs(schema.parameters) do choices[i] = objects_by_type[parameter.type]; assignments = assignments * #choices[i] end
        local stats = {assignments, 0, 0}
        statistics[schema.name] = stats
        local binding, arguments = {}, {}
        local function enumerate(index)
            if index <= #schema.parameters then
                for _, name in ipairs(choices[index]) do
                    arguments[index], binding[schema.parameters[index].name] = name, name
                    enumerate(index + 1)
                end
                return
            end
            local positive, negative = {}, {}
            for _, literal in ipairs(schema.condition) do
                local atom = Grounding.substitute(literal.atom, binding)
                if atom.predicate == "=" or domain.static[atom.predicate] then
                    local truth
                    if atom.predicate == "=" then truth = atom.terms[1] == atom.terms[2] else truth = initial_atoms[atom.key] ~= nil end
                    if truth ~= literal.sign then return end
                elseif literal.sign then positive[atom.key] = atom else negative[atom.key] = atom end
            end
            local adds, deletes = {}, {}
            for _, literal in ipairs(schema.effects) do
                local atom = Grounding.substitute(literal.atom, binding)
                if literal.sign then adds[atom.key] = atom else deletes[atom.key] = atom end
            end
            candidates[#candidates + 1] = {source = schema, arguments = Grounding.copy(arguments), cost = schema.cost,
                pre = positive, neg = negative, add = adds, delete = Grounding.difference(deletes, adds)}
            stats[2] = stats[2] + 1
        end
        enumerate(1)
    end
    local reachable, accepted = {}, {}
    for _, atom in ipairs(problem.initial) do if domain.fluent[atom.predicate] then reachable[atom.key] = atom end end
    while true do
        local changed = false
        for i, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
            if not accepted[i] and Grounding.subset(candidate.pre, reachable) then
                accepted[i], changed = true, true
                for key, atom in pairs(candidate.add) do reachable[key] = atom end
                local stats = statistics[candidate.source.name]
                stats[3] = stats[3] + 1
            end
        end
        if not changed then break end
    end
    local predicate_order, object_order, facts = {}, {}, {}
    for i, name in ipairs(domain.predicate_order) do predicate_order[name] = i end
    for i, name in ipairs(problem.object_order) do object_order[name] = i end
    for _, atom in pairs(reachable) do facts[#facts + 1] = atom end
    table.sort(facts, function(a, b)
        if a.predicate ~= b.predicate then return predicate_order[a.predicate] < predicate_order[b.predicate] end
        for i, term in ipairs(a.terms) do
            if term ~= b.terms[i] then return object_order[term] < object_order[b.terms[i]] end
        end
        return false
    end)
    local fact_numbers, actions, action_numbers = {}, {}, {}
    for i, atom in ipairs(facts) do fact_numbers[atom.key] = i end
    for i, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
        if accepted[i] then
            local action = {number = #actions + 1, source = candidate.source, arguments = candidate.arguments, cost = candidate.cost}
            for _, name in ipairs({"pre", "neg", "add", "delete"}) do
                action[name] = {}
                for key in pairs(candidate[name]) do local number = fact_numbers[key]; if number then action[name][number] = true end end
            end
            actions[#actions + 1] = action
            action_numbers[action.source.name .. " " .. table.concat(action.arguments, " ")] = action.number
        end
    end
    local initial, goal, unreachable, static_count = {}, {}, {}, 0
    for _, atom in ipairs(problem.initial) do
        if domain.fluent[atom.predicate] then initial[fact_numbers[atom.key]] = true else static_count = static_count + 1 end
    end
    for _, atom in ipairs(problem.goals) do
        local number = fact_numbers[atom.key]
        if number then goal[number] = true
        elseif not domain.static[atom.predicate] or not initial_atoms[atom.key] then unreachable[#unreachable + 1] = atom end
    end
    return {name = problem.name, source = problem, objects_by_type = objects_by_type, statistics = statistics,
        candidate_count = #candidates, facts = facts, actions = actions, initial = initial, goal = goal,
        unreachable = unreachable, static_count = static_count, action_numbers = action_numbers}
end

return Grounding

local Sets = require("grounding")
local Search = require("search")
local Heuristics = {}
Heuristics.__index = Heuristics
Heuristics.INF = math.maxinteger
Heuristics.names = {"goalcount", "hmax", "hadd", "ff", "lmcount"}

function Heuristics.new(problem)
    local self = setmetatable({actions = problem.actions, goal = problem.goal, fact_count = #problem.facts,
        achievers = {}, consumers = {}, cache = {}}, Heuristics)
    for i = 1, #problem.facts do self.achievers[i], self.consumers[i] = {}, {} end
    for _, action in ipairs(problem.actions) do
        for fact in pairs(action.add) do local list = self.achievers[fact]; list[#list + 1] = action.number end
        for fact in pairs(action.pre) do local list = self.consumers[fact]; list[#list + 1] = action.number end
    end
    return self
end

function Heuristics:entry(state)
    local key = Sets.key(state)
    if not self.cache[key] then self.cache[key] = {} end
    return self.cache[key]
end

function Heuristics:relaxed_costs(state, maximum)
    local entry, name = self:entry(state), maximum and "maximum" or "additive"
    if entry[name] then return entry[name] end
    local costs = {}
    for i = 1, self.fact_count do costs[i] = state[i] and 0 or self.INF end
    while true do
        local changed = false
        for _, action in ipairs(self.actions) do
            local aggregate, finite = 0, true
            for fact in pairs(action.pre) do
                if costs[fact] == self.INF then finite = false; break end
                aggregate = maximum and math.max(aggregate, costs[fact]) or aggregate + costs[fact]
            end
            if finite then
                local value = action.cost + aggregate
                for fact in pairs(action.add) do if value < costs[fact] then costs[fact], changed = value, true end end
            end
        end
        if not changed then break end
    end
    entry[name] = costs
    return costs
end

function Heuristics:relaxed_plan(state)
    local entry = self:entry(state)
    if entry.plan ~= nil then return entry.plan end
    local costs = self:relaxed_costs(state, false)
    for fact in pairs(self.goal) do if costs[fact] == self.INF then entry.plan = false; return false end end
    local chosen, pending = {}, Sets.sorted(Sets.difference(self.goal, state))
    while #pending > 0 do
        local fact = table.remove(pending)
        local winner, lowest = nil, self.INF
        for _, number in ipairs(self.achievers[fact]) do
            local action, cost, finite = self.actions[number], self.actions[number].cost, true
            for pre in pairs(action.pre) do if costs[pre] == self.INF then finite = false; break end; cost = cost + costs[pre] end
            if finite and cost < lowest then winner, lowest = number, cost end
        end
        if not chosen[winner] then
            chosen[winner] = true
            for pre in pairs(self.actions[winner].pre) do if not state[pre] then pending[#pending + 1] = pre end end
        end
    end
    entry.plan = Sets.sorted(chosen)
    return entry.plan
end

function Heuristics:helpful(state)
    local entry = self:entry(state)
    if entry.helpful then return entry.helpful end
    local result = {}
    for _, number in ipairs(self:relaxed_plan(state) or {}) do
        if Search.applicable(self.actions[number], state) then result[#result + 1] = number end
    end
    entry.helpful = result
    return result
end

function Heuristics:levels(state)
    local entry = self:entry(state)
    if entry.fact_levels then return entry.fact_levels, entry.action_levels end
    local facts, actions, level = {}, {}, 0
    for i = 1, self.fact_count do facts[i] = state[i] and 0 or self.INF end
    for i = 1, #self.actions do actions[i] = self.INF end
    while true do
        local changed = false
        for _, action in ipairs(self.actions) do
            if actions[action.number] == self.INF then
                local enabled = true
                for fact in pairs(action.pre) do if facts[fact] > level then enabled = false; break end end
                if enabled then
                    actions[action.number] = level
                    for fact in pairs(action.add) do if facts[fact] == self.INF then facts[fact], changed = level + 1, true end end
                end
            end
        end
        if not changed then break end
        level = level + 1
    end
    entry.fact_levels, entry.action_levels = facts, actions
    return facts, actions
end

function Heuristics:verified(state, excluded_fact)
    local excluded, reachable = {}, Sets.copy(state)
    for _, number in ipairs(self.achievers[excluded_fact]) do excluded[number] = true end
    while true do
        local changed = false
        for _, action in ipairs(self.actions) do
            if not excluded[action.number] and Sets.subset(action.pre, reachable) then
                for fact in pairs(action.add) do if not reachable[fact] then reachable[fact], changed = true, true end end
            end
        end
        if not changed then break end
    end
    return not Sets.subset(self.goal, reachable)
end

function Heuristics:landmarks(state)
    local entry = self:entry(state)
    if entry.landmarks ~= nil then return entry.landmarks end
    local facts, actions = self:levels(state)
    for fact in pairs(self.goal) do if facts[fact] == self.INF then entry.landmarks = false; return false end end
    local landmarks = Sets.difference(self.goal, state)
    local pending, head, verification = Sets.sorted(landmarks), 1, {}
    while head <= #pending do
        local fact, candidates = pending[head], nil
        head = head + 1
        for _, number in ipairs(self.achievers[fact]) do
            if actions[number] == facts[fact] - 1 then
                candidates = candidates and Sets.intersection(candidates, self.actions[number].pre) or Sets.copy(self.actions[number].pre)
            end
        end
        for _, candidate in ipairs(Sets.sorted(Sets.difference(Sets.difference(candidates, state), landmarks))) do
            if verification[candidate] == nil then verification[candidate] = self:verified(state, candidate) end
            if verification[candidate] then landmarks[candidate] = true; pending[#pending + 1] = candidate end
        end
    end
    entry.landmarks = landmarks
    return landmarks
end

function Heuristics:value(name, state)
    if name == "none" then return 0 end
    if name == "goalcount" then return Sets.size(Sets.difference(self.goal, state)) end
    if name == "hmax" or name == "hadd" then
        local costs, result = self:relaxed_costs(state, name == "hmax"), 0
        for fact in pairs(self.goal) do
            if costs[fact] == self.INF then return self.INF end
            result = name == "hmax" and math.max(result, costs[fact]) or result + costs[fact]
        end
        return result
    end
    if name == "ff" then
        local plan = self:relaxed_plan(state)
        if not plan then return self.INF end
        local cost = 0
        for _, number in ipairs(plan) do cost = cost + self.actions[number].cost end
        return cost
    end
    local landmarks = self:landmarks(state)
    return landmarks and Sets.size(landmarks) or self.INF
end

function Heuristics:values(state)
    local result = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(self.names) do result[name] = self:value(name, state) end
    return result
end

return Heuristics

local Parser = require("pddl_parser")
local Sets = require("grounding")
local Heuristics = require("heuristics")
local Search = require("search")
local Graph = require("graphplan")
local Planner = {}
Planner.__index = Planner

local function append(items, value)
    items[#items + 1] = value
end

local function extend(items, values)
    for _, value in ipairs(values) do append(items, value) end
end

local function action_text(action)
    return "(" .. action.source.name .. (#action.arguments > 0 and " " .. table.concat(action.arguments, " ") or "") .. ")"
end

local function number_list(numbers)
    local values = {}
    for _, number in ipairs(Sets.sorted(numbers)) do append(values, number - 1) end
    return #values == 0 and "-" or table.concat(values, ",")
end

local function headed(heading, items)
    return heading .. " " .. (#items == 0 and "-" or table.concat(items, " "))
end

local function value_text(value)
    return value == Heuristics.INF and "inf" or tostring(value)
end

local function heuristic_text(values)
    local parts = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(Heuristics.names) do append(parts, name .. "=" .. value_text(values[name])) end
    return table.concat(parts, " ")
end

local function read_settings()
    local settings = {runs = {}}
    for line in io.lines("input/params.txt") do
        if line ~= "" and line:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then
            local f = Parser.words(line)
            if f[1] == "run" then append(settings.runs, {f[2], f[3]})
            elseif f[1] == "repair" then settings.repair = {f[2], f[3]}
            else settings[f[1]] = tonumber(f[2]) end
        end
    end
    return settings
end

local function read_candidates()
    local candidates, current = {}, nil
    for line in io.lines("input/candidates.txt") do
        if line ~= "" and line:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then
            local f = Parser.words(line)
            if f[1] == "plan" then current = {number = #candidates + 1, problem = f[2], label = f[3], steps = {}}
            elseif line == "end" then append(candidates, current)
            else
                local fields, arguments = Parser.words(line:sub(2, -2)), {}
                for i = 2, #fields do append(arguments, fields[i]) end
                append(current.steps, {name = fields[1], arguments = arguments})
            end
        end
    end
    return candidates
end

local function argument_error(domain, arguments, expected, types, noun)
    if #arguments ~= #expected then return string.format("expected %d arguments, got %d", #expected, #arguments) end
    for i, argument in ipairs(arguments) do
        if not types[argument] then return "unknown " .. noun .. " " .. argument end
        if not Sets.subtype(domain.parents, types[argument], expected[i]) then
            return string.format("argument %d (%s) is not of type %s", i, argument, expected[i])
        end
    end
end

local function validate_domain(domain)
    local kept, diagnostics, used = {}, {}, {}
    for _, action in ipairs(domain.actions) do
        local error, parameters = nil, {}
        for _, parameter in ipairs(action.parameters) do
            parameters[parameter.name] = parameter.type
            if domain.parents[parameter.type] == nil then error = "unknown type " .. parameter.type; break end
        end
        if not error then
            local literals = Sets.copy(action.condition)
            extend(literals, action.effects)
            for _, literal in ipairs(literals) do
                local atom = literal.atom
                if atom.predicate ~= "=" and not domain.predicates[atom.predicate] then error = "unknown predicate " .. atom.predicate
                else error = argument_error(domain, atom.terms, atom.predicate == "=" and {"object", "object"}
                    or domain.predicates[atom.predicate], parameters, "variable") end
                if error then error = atom.key .. ": " .. error; break end
            end
        end
        if error then append(diagnostics, "error: action " .. action.name .. ": " .. error)
        else
            append(kept, action)
            for _, literal in ipairs(action.condition) do used[literal.atom.predicate] = true end
            for _, literal in ipairs(action.effects) do used[literal.atom.predicate] = true end
        end
    end
    domain.actions, domain.by_name = kept, {}
    for _, action in ipairs(kept) do domain.by_name[action.name] = action end
    for _, predicate in ipairs(domain.predicate_order) do
        if not used[predicate] then append(diagnostics, "warning: predicate " .. predicate .. " is not used by any action") end
    end
    domain.fluent, domain.static = Sets.classes(domain)
    domain.diagnostics = diagnostics
end

local function validate_problem(domain, problem)
    local diagnostics = {}
    for _, pair in ipairs({{"init", "initial"}, {"goal", "goals"}}) do
        local kept, seen = {}, {}
        for _, atom in ipairs(problem[pair[2]]) do
            local error
            if not domain.predicates[atom.predicate] then error = "unknown predicate " .. atom.predicate
            else error = argument_error(domain, atom.terms, domain.predicates[atom.predicate], problem.objects, "object") end
            if not error and seen[atom.key] then error = "duplicate" end
            if error then append(diagnostics, "warning: " .. pair[1] .. " " .. atom.key .. ": " .. error)
            else append(kept, atom); seen[atom.key] = true end
        end
        problem[pair[2]] = kept
    end
    problem.diagnostics = diagnostics
end

local function validation(status, messages, correct)
    return {status = status, messages = messages, correct = correct}
end

local function validate_steps(domain, problem, steps)
    local world, cost = Sets.atom_set(problem.initial), 0
    for position, step in ipairs(steps) do
        local notation = "(" .. step.name .. (#step.arguments > 0 and " " .. table.concat(step.arguments, " ") or "") .. ")"
        local heading = string.format("step %d %s: ", position, notation)
        local schema = domain.by_name[step.name]
        if not schema then return validation("invalid", {heading .. "unknown action " .. step.name}, position - 1) end
        local expected, assignment = {}, {}
        for i, parameter in ipairs(schema.parameters) do expected[i], assignment[parameter.name] = parameter.type, step.arguments[i] end
        local error = argument_error(domain, step.arguments, expected, problem.objects, "object")
        if error then return validation("invalid", {heading .. error}, position - 1) end
        for _, literal in ipairs(schema.condition) do
            local atom = Sets.substitute(literal.atom, assignment)
            local truth
            if atom.predicate == "=" then truth = atom.terms[1] == atom.terms[2] else truth = world[atom.key] ~= nil end
            if truth ~= literal.sign then
                local text = literal.sign and atom.key or "(not " .. atom.key .. ")"
                return validation("invalid", {heading .. "precondition " .. text .. " is false"}, position - 1)
            end
        end
        local adds, deletes = {}, {}
        for _, literal in ipairs(schema.effects) do
            local atom = Sets.substitute(literal.atom, assignment)
            if literal.sign then adds[atom.key] = atom else deletes[atom.key] = atom end
        end
        world, cost = Sets.union(Sets.difference(world, deletes), adds), cost + schema.cost
    end
    local missing = {}
    for _, atom in ipairs(problem.goals) do if not world[atom.key] then append(missing, "unsatisfied goal " .. atom.key) end end
    if #missing > 0 then return validation("goal not reached", missing, #steps) end
    return validation("valid", {string.format("length=%d cost=%d", #steps, cost)}, #steps)
end

local function verdict(checked)
    return checked.status .. (checked.status == "valid" and " " or ": ") .. checked.messages[1]
end

local function plan_steps(problem, plan)
    local steps = {}
    for _, number in ipairs(plan) do local action = problem.actions[number]; append(steps, {name = action.source.name, arguments = action.arguments}) end
    return steps
end

local function plan_cost(problem, plan)
    local cost = 0
    for _, number in ipairs(plan) do cost = cost + problem.actions[number].cost end
    return cost
end

local function interferes(first, second)
    return Sets.intersects(first.delete, Sets.union(second.pre, second.add)) or Sets.intersects(second.delete, Sets.union(first.pre, first.add))
        or Sets.intersects(first.add, second.neg) or Sets.intersects(second.add, first.neg)
end

local function parallelize(problem, plan)
    local assigned, layers = {}, {}
    for position, number in ipairs(plan) do
        local action, layer = problem.actions[number], 1
        for earlier = 1, position - 1 do
            local previous = problem.actions[plan[earlier]]
            if Sets.intersects(previous.add, action.pre) or Sets.intersects(previous.delete, action.neg) or interferes(previous, action) then
                layer = math.max(layer, assigned[earlier] + 1)
            end
        end
        assigned[position] = layer
        while #layers < layer do append(layers, {}) end
        append(layers[layer], number)
    end
    return layers
end

local function validate_parallel(problem, layers)
    local state = problem.initial
    for position, layer in ipairs(layers) do
        local deletes, adds = {}, {}
        for i, number in ipairs(layer) do
            local action = problem.actions[number]
            if not Search.applicable(action, state) then return "invalid at layer " .. position end
            for j = i + 1, #layer do if interferes(action, problem.actions[layer[j]]) then return "invalid at layer " .. position end end
            deletes, adds = Sets.union(deletes, action.delete), Sets.union(adds, action.add)
        end
        state = Sets.union(Sets.difference(state, deletes), adds)
    end
    return Sets.subset(problem.goal, state) and "valid" or "goal not reached"
end

local function improve(problem, plan)
    local sequence, position = Sets.copy(plan), 1
    while position <= #sequence do
        local state, prefix, applied = problem.initial, {}, {}
        for i = 1, position - 1 do state = Search.apply(problem.actions[sequence[i]], state); append(prefix, sequence[i]) end
        for i = position + 1, #sequence do
            local action = problem.actions[sequence[i]]
            if Search.applicable(action, state) then state = Search.apply(action, state); append(applied, action.number) end
        end
        if Sets.subset(problem.goal, state) then extend(prefix, applied); sequence = prefix else position = position + 1 end
    end
    return sequence
end

local function reached_landmarks(problem, plan, landmarks)
    local state, reached = problem.initial, {}
    for _, number in ipairs(plan) do state = Search.apply(problem.actions[number], state); reached = Sets.union(reached, Sets.intersection(state, landmarks)) end
    return reached
end

local function transform_negatives(problem)
    local negative = {}
    for _, action in ipairs(problem.actions) do negative = Sets.union(negative, action.neg) end
    local ordered, complements, actions, initial = Sets.sorted(negative), {}, {}, Sets.copy(problem.initial)
    for i, fact in ipairs(ordered) do complements[fact] = #problem.facts + i end
    for _, action in ipairs(problem.actions) do
        local pre, add, delete = Sets.copy(action.pre), Sets.copy(action.add), Sets.copy(action.delete)
        for fact in pairs(action.neg) do pre[complements[fact]] = true end
        for fact in pairs(action.delete) do if complements[fact] then add[complements[fact]] = true end end
        for fact in pairs(action.add) do if complements[fact] then delete[complements[fact]] = true end end
        append(actions, {number = action.number, pre = pre, add = add, delete = delete})
    end
    for _, fact in ipairs(ordered) do if not problem.initial[fact] then initial[complements[fact]] = true end end
    return actions, initial, #ordered
end

function Planner.new()
    local domain = Parser.domain(Parser.read("input/domain.txt"))
    validate_domain(domain)
    local settings, tags, totals = read_settings(), {}, {}
    for _, pair in ipairs(settings.runs) do append(tags, table.concat(pair, " ")); append(totals, {solved = 0, best = 0, expanded = 0, generated = 0}) end
    append(tags, "graphplan")
    append(totals, {solved = 0, best = 0, expanded = 0, generated = 0})
    return setmetatable({domain = domain, sources = Parser.problems(Parser.read("input/problems.txt")), settings = settings,
        candidates = read_candidates(), tags = tags, totals = totals, grounding_lines = {}, plan_lines = {}, graph_lines = {},
        validation_lines = {}, comparison_lines = {"problem,algorithm,heuristic,length,cost,expanded,generated"},
        problems = {}, evaluators = {}, summaries = {}, validated_plans = 0, valid_plans = 0, valid_candidates = 0}, Planner)
end

function Planner:domain_report()
    local domain, lines = self.domain, self.grounding_lines
    append(lines, "== domain " .. domain.name .. " ==")
    extend(lines, domain.diagnostics)
    for _, kind in ipairs(domain.type_order) do
        local chain, current = {}, kind
        while current do append(chain, current); current = domain.parents[current] end
        append(lines, "type " .. table.concat(chain, " < "))
    end
    for _, name in ipairs(domain.predicate_order) do append(lines, string.format("predicate %s/%d %s", name,
        #domain.predicates[name], domain.fluent[name] and "fluent" or "static")) end
    for _, action in ipairs(domain.actions) do
        local adds, deletes = 0, 0
        for _, literal in ipairs(action.effects) do if literal.sign then adds = adds + 1 else deletes = deletes + 1 end end
        append(lines, string.format("action %s/%d cost=%d pre=%d add=%d del=%d", action.name, #action.parameters,
            action.cost, #action.condition, adds, deletes))
    end
end

function Planner:grounding_report(problem)
    local lines = self.grounding_lines
    append(lines, "")
    append(lines, "== problem " .. problem.name .. " ==")
    extend(lines, problem.source.diagnostics)
    append(lines, "objects: " .. #problem.source.object_order)
    for _, kind in ipairs(self.domain.type_order) do append(lines, headed("  " .. kind .. ":", problem.objects_by_type[kind])) end
    append(lines, "static facts: " .. problem.static_count)
    for _, action in ipairs(self.domain.actions) do
        local s = problem.statistics[action.name]
        append(lines, string.format("schema %s: assignments=%d candidates=%d reachable=%d", action.name, s[1], s[2], s[3]))
    end
    append(lines, string.format("candidates: %d reachable: %d", problem.candidate_count, #problem.actions))
    append(lines, string.format("facts: %d init: %d goals: %d", #problem.facts, Sets.size(problem.initial), Sets.size(problem.goal)))
    for _, atom in ipairs(problem.unreachable) do append(lines, "unreachable goal: " .. atom.key) end
    local counts, entries = {}, {}
    for _, atom in ipairs(problem.facts) do counts[atom.predicate] = (counts[atom.predicate] or 0) + 1 end
    for _, name in ipairs(self.domain.predicate_order) do if self.domain.fluent[name] then append(entries, name .. "=" .. (counts[name] or 0)) end end
    append(lines, headed("facts by predicate:", entries))
    append(lines, "facts:")
    for i, atom in ipairs(problem.facts) do append(lines, string.format("  %d %s", i - 1, atom.key)) end
    append(lines, "actions:")
    for _, action in ipairs(problem.actions) do append(lines, string.format("  %d %s cost=%d pre=%s neg=%s add=%s del=%s",
        action.number - 1, action_text(action), action.cost, number_list(action.pre), number_list(action.neg), number_list(action.add), number_list(action.delete))) end
end

function Planner:initial_report(problem, evaluator)
    local values = evaluator:values(problem.initial)
    local landmarks, relaxed = evaluator:landmarks(problem.initial) or {}, evaluator:relaxed_plan(problem.initial) or {}
    local lines = self.plan_lines
    append(lines, "initial h: " .. heuristic_text(values))
    append(lines, "landmarks: " .. Sets.size(landmarks))
    for _, number in ipairs(Sets.sorted(landmarks)) do append(lines, "  " .. problem.facts[number].key) end
    append(lines, string.format("relaxed plan: length=%d cost=%s", #relaxed, value_text(values.ff)))
    for _, number in ipairs(relaxed) do append(lines, "  " .. action_text(problem.actions[number])) end
    local helpful = {}
    for _, number in ipairs(evaluator:helpful(problem.initial)) do append(helpful, action_text(problem.actions[number])) end
    append(lines, headed("helpful:", helpful))
    return landmarks
end

function Planner:plan_report(problem, tag, plan, landmarks, earlier)
    local lines, key = self.plan_lines, table.concat(plan, ",")
    local first = earlier[key]
    if not first then earlier[key] = tag end
    append(lines, string.format("plan: length=%d cost=%d", #plan, plan_cost(problem, plan)) .. (first and " (same as " .. first .. ")" or ""))
    local counts = {}
    for position, number in ipairs(plan) do
        local action = problem.actions[number]
        append(lines, string.format("  %d %s", position, action_text(action)))
        counts[action.source.name] = (counts[action.source.name] or 0) + 1
    end
    local schemas = {}
    for _, action in ipairs(self.domain.actions) do if counts[action.name] then append(schemas, action.name .. "=" .. counts[action.name]) end end
    append(lines, headed("schemas:", schemas))
    local layers = parallelize(problem, plan)
    append(lines, "parallel: layers=" .. #layers)
    for i, layer in ipairs(layers) do
        local names = {}
        for _, number in ipairs(layer) do append(names, action_text(problem.actions[number])) end
        append(lines, headed("  " .. i .. ":", names))
    end
    local improved = improve(problem, plan)
    local removed = #plan - #improved
    append(lines, string.format("improved: length=%d cost=%d removed=%d", #improved, plan_cost(problem, improved), removed))
    if removed > 0 then for i, number in ipairs(improved) do append(lines, string.format("  %d %s", i, action_text(problem.actions[number]))) end end
    local reached = reached_landmarks(problem, plan, landmarks)
    append(lines, string.format("landmarks reached: %d/%d", Sets.size(reached), Sets.size(landmarks)))
    for _, number in ipairs(Sets.sorted(Sets.difference(landmarks, reached))) do append(lines, "  missed " .. problem.facts[number].key) end
    local checked = validate_steps(self.domain, problem.source, plan_steps(problem, plan))
    local checked_improved = validate_steps(self.domain, problem.source, plan_steps(problem, improved))
    append(self.validation_lines, tag .. ": " .. verdict(checked))
    append(self.validation_lines, "  parallel: " .. validate_parallel(problem, layers))
    append(self.validation_lines, "  improved: " .. verdict(checked_improved))
    self.validated_plans = self.validated_plans + 1
    if checked.status == "valid" then self.valid_plans = self.valid_plans + 1 end
end

function Planner:search_result_report(problem, tag, outcome, landmarks, earlier)
    append(self.plan_lines, "-- " .. tag .. " --")
    if #problem.unreachable > 0 then append(self.plan_lines, "result: FAIL (unreachable goal)"); return end
    local state = outcome.status == "solved" and "solved" or "FAIL (" .. outcome.status .. ")"
    append(self.plan_lines, string.format("result: %s expanded=%d generated=%d", state, outcome.expanded, outcome.generated))
    if outcome.status == "solved" then self:plan_report(problem, tag, outcome.plan, landmarks, earlier) end
end

function Planner:graph_report(problem, outcome, complements)
    local lines = self.graph_lines
    if #problem.unreachable > 0 then append(lines, "result: FAIL (unreachable goal)"); return end
    append(lines, "complementary facts: " .. complements)
    extend(lines, outcome.lines)
    local counts = string.format(" searched=%d memo_hits=%d tried=%d", outcome.expanded, outcome.memo_hits, outcome.generated)
    if outcome.status == "solved" then
        append(lines, string.format("result: solved levels=%d length=%d cost=%d", #outcome.layers, #outcome.plan, plan_cost(problem, outcome.plan)) .. counts)
        for i, layer in ipairs(outcome.layers) do
            local names = {}
            for _, number in ipairs(layer) do append(names, action_text(problem.actions[number])) end
            append(lines, headed("layer " .. i .. ":", names))
        end
    else append(lines, "result: FAIL (" .. outcome.status .. ")" .. counts) end
end

function Planner:profile_report(problem, evaluator, tag, plan)
    local lines, state, remaining, overestimates = self.plan_lines, problem.initial, plan_cost(problem, plan), {}
    for _, name in ipairs(Heuristics.names) do overestimates[name] = 0 end
    append(lines, "-- profile (" .. tag .. ") --")
    for position = 0, #plan do
        local values = evaluator:values(state)
        append(lines, string.format("  %d: h*=%d %s", position, remaining, heuristic_text(values)))
        for _, name in ipairs(Heuristics.names) do if values[name] > remaining then overestimates[name] = overestimates[name] + 1 end end
        if position < #plan then
            local action = problem.actions[plan[position + 1]]
            state, remaining = Search.apply(action, state), remaining - action.cost
        end
    end
    local entries = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(Heuristics.names) do append(entries, name .. "=" .. overestimates[name]) end
    append(lines, "overestimates: " .. table.concat(entries, " "))
    append(lines, "-- causal links (" .. tag .. ") --")
    local suppliers = {}
    for position, number in ipairs(plan) do
        local action, links = problem.actions[number], {}
        for _, fact in ipairs(Sets.sorted(action.pre)) do append(links, problem.facts[fact].key .. "<-" .. (suppliers[fact] or 0)) end
        append(lines, headed("  " .. position .. " " .. action_text(action) .. ":", links))
        for fact in pairs(action.add) do suppliers[fact] = position end
    end
    entries = {}
    for _, fact in ipairs(Sets.sorted(problem.goal)) do append(entries, problem.facts[fact].key .. "<-" .. (suppliers[fact] or 0)) end
    append(lines, headed("  goal:", entries))
end

function Planner:summarize_problem(problem, outcomes, proof)
    local solved, best = 0, nil
    for _, outcome in ipairs(outcomes) do
        if outcome.status == "solved" then
            solved = solved + 1
            local cost = plan_cost(problem, outcome.plan)
            best = best and math.min(best, cost) or cost
        end
    end
    local optimal = "unknown"
    if proof then optimal = tostring(plan_cost(problem, outcomes[proof].plan))
    else
        for _, outcome in ipairs(outcomes) do
            if outcome.status == "unreachable goal" or outcome.status == "dead end" or outcome.status == "exhausted" or outcome.status == "unreachable" then optimal = "none"; break end
        end
    end
    self.summaries[problem.name] = {solved = solved, best = best, optimal = optimal}
    for index, outcome in ipairs(outcomes) do
        local pair, totals = self.settings.runs[index] or {"graphplan", "none"}, self.totals[index]
        totals.expanded, totals.generated = totals.expanded + outcome.expanded, totals.generated + outcome.generated
        local length, cost = "-", "-"
        if outcome.status == "solved" then
            length, cost = #outcome.plan, plan_cost(problem, outcome.plan)
            totals.solved = totals.solved + 1
            if cost == best then totals.best = totals.best + 1 end
        end
        append(self.comparison_lines, table.concat({problem.name, pair[1], pair[2], length, cost, outcome.expanded, outcome.generated}, ","))
    end
end

function Planner:solve_problem(source)
    validate_problem(self.domain, source)
    local problem = Sets.ground(self.domain, source)
    self.problems[problem.name] = problem
    self:grounding_report(problem)
    for _, lines in ipairs({self.plan_lines, self.graph_lines, self.validation_lines}) do append(lines, "== problem " .. problem.name .. " ==") end
    local outcomes, earlier, proof, evaluator, landmarks = {}, {}, nil, nil, {}
    if #problem.unreachable > 0 then append(self.plan_lines, "initial h: unreachable goal")
    else
        evaluator = Heuristics.new(problem)
        self.evaluators[problem.name] = evaluator
        landmarks = self:initial_report(problem, evaluator)
    end
    for index, pair in ipairs(self.settings.runs) do
        local algorithm, heuristic, outcome = pair[1], pair[2]
        if #problem.unreachable > 0 then outcome = Search.result("unreachable goal")
        else outcome = Search.run(problem, problem.initial, algorithm, heuristic, self.settings.budget, self.settings.weight, evaluator) end
        append(outcomes, outcome)
        self:search_result_report(problem, self.tags[index], outcome, landmarks, earlier)
        if not proof and ((algorithm == "ucs" and heuristic == "none") or (algorithm == "astar" and heuristic == "hmax")) and outcome.status == "solved" then proof = index end
    end
    local graph, complements = nil, 0
    if #problem.unreachable > 0 then graph = Search.result("unreachable goal")
    else
        local actions, initial
        actions, initial, complements = transform_negatives(problem)
        graph = Graph.new(actions, initial, problem.goal, self.settings.graphplan):run()
    end
    append(outcomes, graph)
    self:search_result_report(problem, "graphplan", graph, landmarks, earlier)
    self:graph_report(problem, graph, complements)
    if proof then self:profile_report(problem, evaluator, self.tags[proof], outcomes[proof].plan) end
    self:summarize_problem(problem, outcomes, proof)
    for _, lines in ipairs({self.plan_lines, self.graph_lines, self.validation_lines}) do append(lines, "") end
end

function Planner:summary_report()
    append(self.plan_lines, "== summary ==")
    for _, source in ipairs(self.sources) do
        local summary = self.summaries[source.name]
        append(self.plan_lines, string.format("%s: solved=%d/%d best=%s optimal=%s", source.name, summary.solved,
            #self.tags, summary.best ~= nil and tostring(summary.best) or "-", summary.optimal))
    end
    for index, tag in ipairs(self.tags) do
        local totals = self.totals[index]
        append(self.plan_lines, string.format("%s: solved=%d best=%d expanded=%d generated=%d", tag, totals.solved,
            totals.best, totals.expanded, totals.generated))
    end
end

function Planner:mapped_steps(problem, steps, count)
    local plan = {}
    for i = 1, count or #steps do
        local step = steps[i]
        append(plan, assert(problem.action_numbers[step.name .. " " .. table.concat(step.arguments, " ")]))
    end
    return plan
end

function Planner:repair_candidate(problem, candidate, checked)
    if #problem.unreachable > 0 then append(self.validation_lines, "  repair: FAIL (unreachable goal)"); return end
    local prefix = self:mapped_steps(problem, candidate.steps, checked.correct)
    local state = problem.initial
    for _, number in ipairs(prefix) do state = Search.apply(problem.actions[number], state) end
    local pair = self.settings.repair
    local outcome = Search.run(problem, state, pair[1], pair[2], self.settings.budget, self.settings.weight, self.evaluators[problem.name])
    if outcome.status ~= "solved" then append(self.validation_lines, "  repair: FAIL (" .. outcome.status .. ")"); return end
    local repaired = Sets.copy(prefix)
    extend(repaired, outcome.plan)
    local checked_repair = validate_steps(self.domain, problem.source, plan_steps(problem, repaired))
    append(self.validation_lines, string.format("  repair: kept=%d added=%d %s", #prefix, #outcome.plan, verdict(checked_repair)))
    for position, number in ipairs(repaired) do append(self.validation_lines, string.format("    %d %s", position, action_text(problem.actions[number]))) end
end

function Planner:candidate_report()
    local lines = self.validation_lines
    append(lines, "== candidates ==")
    for _, candidate in ipairs(self.candidates) do
        local problem = self.problems[candidate.problem]
        local checked = validate_steps(self.domain, problem.source, candidate.steps)
        local heading = string.format("candidate %d %s %s: ", candidate.number, candidate.problem, candidate.label)
        if checked.status == "valid" then
            self.valid_candidates = self.valid_candidates + 1
            append(lines, heading .. verdict(checked))
            local mapped = self:mapped_steps(problem, candidate.steps)
            local improved, best = improve(problem, mapped), self.summaries[problem.name].best
            append(lines, string.format("  improved: length=%d cost=%d removed=%d best known=%s", #improved,
                plan_cost(problem, improved), #mapped - #improved, best ~= nil and tostring(best) or "-"))
        else
            append(lines, heading .. checked.status)
            for _, message in ipairs(checked.messages) do append(lines, "  " .. message) end
            self:repair_candidate(problem, candidate, checked)
        end
    end
    extend(lines, {"", "== summary ==", string.format("plans: %d valid: %d", self.validated_plans, self.valid_plans),
        string.format("candidates: %d valid: %d", #self.candidates, self.valid_candidates)})
end

function Planner:write_reports()
    assert(os.execute("mkdir -p output"))
    for _, report in ipairs({{"grounding.txt", self.grounding_lines}, {"plans.txt", self.plan_lines},
        {"graphplan.txt", self.graph_lines}, {"validation.txt", self.validation_lines}, {"comparison.csv", self.comparison_lines}}) do
        local file = assert(io.open("output/" .. report[1], "wb"))
        for _, line in ipairs(report[2]) do file:write(line, "\n") end
        file:close()
    end
end

function Planner:run()
    self:domain_report()
    for _, source in ipairs(self.sources) do self:solve_problem(source) end
    self:summary_report()
    self:candidate_report()
    self:write_reports()
end

Planner.new():run()

local Parser = {}

function Parser.read(path)
    local file = assert(io.open(path, "rb"))
    local text = file:read("a")
    file:close()
    return text
end

function Parser.words(text)
    local result = {}
    for word in text:gmatch("%S+") do result[#result + 1] = word end
    return result
end

local function slice(items, first)
    local result = {}
    for i = first, #items do result[#result + 1] = items[i] end
    return result
end

function Parser.expressions(text)
    local cleaned = {}
    for line in (text .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do cleaned[#cleaned + 1] = line:match("^[^;]*") end
    text = table.concat(cleaned, "\n"):gsub("([()])", " %1 ")
    local roots = {}
    local stack = {roots}
    for token in text:gmatch("%S+") do
        if token == "(" then
            local child, parent = {}, stack[#stack]
            parent[#parent + 1], stack[#stack + 1] = child, child
        elseif token == ")" then stack[#stack] = nil
        else local current = stack[#stack]; current[#current + 1] = token end
    end
    return roots
end

function Parser.typed_list(words)
    local result, pending, i = {}, {}, 1
    while i <= #words do
        if words[i] == "-" then
            for _, name in ipairs(pending) do result[#result + 1] = {name = name, type = words[i + 1]} end
            pending, i = {}, i + 2
        else pending[#pending + 1], i = words[i], i + 1 end
    end
    for _, name in ipairs(pending) do result[#result + 1] = {name = name, type = "object"} end
    return result
end

function Parser.atom(expression)
    return {predicate = expression[1], terms = slice(expression, 2), key = "(" .. table.concat(expression, " ") .. ")"}
end

function Parser.elements(expression, empty)
    local conjunction = expression[1] == "and"
    for i = 2, #expression do if type(expression[i]) ~= "table" then conjunction = false end end
    return conjunction and (empty ~= false or #expression > 1) and slice(expression, 2) or {expression}
end

local function literal(expression)
    if expression[1] == "not" and #expression == 2 and type(expression[2]) == "table" then
        return {sign = false, atom = Parser.atom(expression[2])}
    end
    return {sign = true, atom = Parser.atom(expression)}
end

function Parser.domain(text)
    local expression = Parser.expressions(text)[1]
    local domain = {name = expression[2][2], parents = {object = false}, type_order = {"object"},
        predicates = {}, predicate_order = {}, actions = {}}
    for index = 3, #expression do
        local section = expression[index]
        if section[1] == ":types" then
            for i = 2, #section do
                local name = section[i]
                if name ~= "-" and domain.parents[name] == nil then
                    domain.parents[name] = "object"
                    domain.type_order[#domain.type_order + 1] = name
                end
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(Parser.typed_list(slice(section, 2))) do domain.parents[item.name] = item.type end
        elseif section[1] == ":predicates" then
            for i = 2, #section do
                local declaration, types = section[i], {}
                for _, item in ipairs(Parser.typed_list(slice(declaration, 2))) do types[#types + 1] = item.type end
                domain.predicates[declaration[1]] = types
                domain.predicate_order[#domain.predicate_order + 1] = declaration[1]
            end
        elseif section[1] == ":action" then
            local fields = {}
            for i = 3, #section, 2 do fields[section[i]] = section[i + 1] end
            local action = {name = section[2], parameters = Parser.typed_list(fields[":parameters"]), condition = {}, effects = {}, cost = 1}
            if fields[":precondition"] then
                for _, item in ipairs(Parser.elements(fields[":precondition"])) do action.condition[#action.condition + 1] = literal(item) end
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(Parser.elements(fields[":effect"], false)) do
                if item[1] == "increase" and #item == 3 and type(item[2]) == "table" and #item[2] == 1 and item[2][1] == "total-cost" then action.cost = tonumber(item[3])
                else action.effects[#action.effects + 1] = literal(item) end
            end
            domain.actions[#domain.actions + 1] = action
        end
    end
    return domain
end

function Parser.problems(text)
    local problems = {}
    for _, expression in ipairs(Parser.expressions(text)) do
        local sections = {}
        for i = 3, #expression do sections[expression[i][1]] = slice(expression[i], 2) end
        local problem = {name = expression[2][2], objects = {}, object_order = {}, initial = {}, goals = {}}
        for _, item in ipairs(Parser.typed_list(sections[":objects"])) do
            problem.objects[item.name] = item.type
            problem.object_order[#problem.object_order + 1] = item.name
        end
        for _, item in ipairs(sections[":init"]) do problem.initial[#problem.initial + 1] = Parser.atom(item) end
        for _, item in ipairs(Parser.elements(sections[":goal"][1], false)) do problem.goals[#problem.goals + 1] = Parser.atom(item) end
        problems[#problems + 1] = problem
    end
    return problems
end

return Parser

local Sets = require("grounding")
local Search = {}

function Search.applicable(action, state)
    return Sets.subset(action.pre, state) and not Sets.intersects(action.neg, state)
end

function Search.apply(action, state)
    return Sets.union(Sets.difference(state, action.delete), action.add)
end

function Search.result(status, expanded, generated, plan)
    return {status = status, expanded = expanded or 0, generated = generated or 0, plan = plan or {}}
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Search.heap()
    return setmetatable({items = {}}, Heap)
end

local function less(a, b)
    if a.f ~= b.f then return a.f < b.f end
    if a.h ~= b.h then return a.h < b.h end
    return a.serial < b.serial
end

function Heap:push(node)
    local items, i = self.items, #self.items + 1
    while i > 1 do
        local parent = i // 2
        if not less(node, items[parent]) then break end
        items[i], i = items[parent], parent
    end
    items[i] = node
end

function Heap:pop()
    local items, result = self.items, self.items[1]
    local last = table.remove(items)
    if #items > 0 then
        local i = 1
        while i * 2 <= #items do
            local child = i * 2
            if child < #items and less(items[child + 1], items[child]) then child = child + 1 end
            if not less(items[child], last) then break end
            items[i], i = items[child], child
        end
        items[i] = last
    end
    return result
end

local function reconstruct(node)
    local reverse, plan = {}, {}
    while node.parent do reverse[#reverse + 1], node = node.action, node.parent end
    for i = #reverse, 1, -1 do plan[#plan + 1] = reverse[i] end
    return plan
end

local function priority(algorithm, g, depth, h, weight)
    if algorithm == "bfs" then return depth end
    if algorithm == "ucs" then return g end
    if algorithm == "gbfs" then return h end
    return g + h * (algorithm == "wastar" and weight or 1)
end

local function best_first(problem, start, algorithm, heuristic, budget, weight, evaluator)
    local h = evaluator:value(heuristic, start)
    if h == evaluator.INF then return Search.result("dead end") end
    local queue, best = Search.heap(), {[Sets.key(start)] = 0}
    queue:push({state = start, g = 0, depth = 0, f = priority(algorithm, 0, 0, h, weight), h = h, serial = 0})
    local serial, expanded, generated = 1, 0, 0
    local reopen = algorithm == "ucs" or algorithm == "astar" or algorithm == "wastar"
    while #queue.items > 0 do
        local node = queue:pop()
        if not reopen or node.g <= best[Sets.key(node.state)] then
            if Sets.subset(problem.goal, node.state) then return Search.result("solved", expanded, generated, reconstruct(node)) end
            if expanded == budget then return Search.result("budget", expanded, generated) end
            expanded = expanded + 1
            for _, action in ipairs(problem.actions) do
                if Search.applicable(action, node.state) then
                    local state, cost = Search.apply(action, node.state), node.g + action.cost
                    generated = generated + 1
                    local key = Sets.key(state)
                    if best[key] == nil or (reopen and cost < best[key]) then
                        best[key] = cost
                        local value = evaluator:value(heuristic, state)
                        if value ~= evaluator.INF then
                            queue:push({state = state, g = cost, depth = node.depth + 1, parent = node, action = action.number,
                                f = priority(algorithm, cost, node.depth + 1, value, weight), h = value, serial = serial})
                            serial = serial + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return Search.result("exhausted", expanded, generated)
end

local function hill_climbing(problem, start, heuristic, budget, evaluator)
    local current, plan, current_h = start, {}, evaluator:value(heuristic, start)
    local expanded, generated = 0, 0
    if current_h == evaluator.INF then return Search.result("dead end") end
    while not Sets.subset(problem.goal, current) do
        local queue, visited, head, improved = {{state = current, prefix = {}}}, {[Sets.key(current)] = true}, 1, false
        while head <= #queue and not improved do
            local entry = queue[head]
            head = head + 1
            if expanded == budget then return Search.result("budget", expanded, generated) end
            expanded = expanded + 1
            for _, number in ipairs(evaluator:helpful(entry.state)) do
                local successor = Search.apply(problem.actions[number], entry.state)
                generated = generated + 1
                local key = Sets.key(successor)
                if not visited[key] then
                    visited[key] = true
                    local value = evaluator:value(heuristic, successor)
                    if value ~= evaluator.INF then
                        local path = Sets.copy(entry.prefix)
                        path[#path + 1] = number
                        if value < current_h then
                            for _, action in ipairs(path) do plan[#plan + 1] = action end
                            current, current_h, improved = successor, value, true
                            break
                        end
                        queue[#queue + 1] = {state = successor, prefix = path}
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if not improved then return Search.result("stuck", expanded, generated) end
    end
    return Search.result("solved", expanded, generated, plan)
end

function Search.run(problem, start, algorithm, heuristic, budget, weight, evaluator)
    if algorithm == "ehc" then return hill_climbing(problem, start, heuristic, budget, evaluator) end
    return best_first(problem, start, algorithm, heuristic, budget, weight, evaluator)
end

return Search
